intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for HistoryEvent. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Stream Processing & History. Immutable published-language record broadcast downstream to the analytics consumers. Invariants: revisionNo >= 0 (0 = none, first revision = 1, enforced by IllegalArgumentException), windowSize >= 0, non-null type/sample, non-blank correlationId.

methods.signature: HistoryEvent(HistoryEventType type, TelemetrySample sample, int revisionNo, int windowSize, String correlationId)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); type and sample non-null; revisionNo >= 0 where 0 means no revision and the first Event Revision of a sample is 1; windowSize >= 0; correlationId non-blank.
Number of samples in the buffered window; 0 for non-window events.
